'''High Justice''' was the title held by [[Vaylin]], sister of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]] of the [[Eternal Empire]], and leader of the [[Knights of Zakuul]]. The individual known as [[Yuriem]] held the position before he was executed for making the crime of profaning the [[Tenebrae|Immortal Emperor's]] name.<ref name="TOR" />
